# `fnox config-files`

- **Usage:** `fnox config-files`

List all config files that would be loaded

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Inspect the effective file stack before debugging an unexpected value. An explicit config path skips directory discovery and adjacent local overrides; the global config still loads.

```sh
fnox config-files
fnox --profile staging config-files
fnox -c ./fnox.toml config-files
```
